card.name: The word never after has or and
card.fires_on: The word "never" right after "has" or a subject, mostly in phrases like "has never been greater" in general web prose. Weaker on a few other words such as "not" or "up".

modes.label: has never been
modes.description: "never" after "has" in claims that something is more urgent or important than ever.
modes.example: The urgency to act has<< never>> been greater, especially in sub-Saharan Africa

modes.label: never after a subject or and
modes.description: "never" or "not" negating a past event in a narrative sentence.
modes.example: They started on June 8, 1924 to scale the summit via the north col route and<< never>> returned.

card.plain: It fires on the word "never" in sentences like "has never been greater" or "never returned".
